headlines.title: US Forces Strike Iranian Missile Launchers Near Strait of Hormuz
headlines.description: The United States and Iran are trading attacks for the first time in weeks, just days after the war reached the six-month mark. US CENTCOM says it struck Larak Island where missile launchers were preparing to deploy mines into the Strait of Hormuz. NBC’s Matt Bradley reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Supreme Court allows Trump to continue White House ballroom construction
headlines.description: The Supreme Court allows the president to move forward with the construction of his White House ballroom. NBC News Legal Affairs Reporter Gary Grumbach explains the latest developments.

headlines.title: At least two dead after catastrophic Grand Canyon flooding
headlines.description: Officials say at least two people are dead and over a dozen others are missing after catastrophic floods struck a remote area of the Grand Canyon. KPNX's Kyle Simchuk reports with a live look at the current state of the canyon.

headlines.title: Rescuers Struggle to Reach Areas Devastated by Nepal Floods
headlines.description: Rescue efforts are also intensifying in Nepal and Tibet where thousands remain missing, including dozens of Americans, nearly a week after catastrophic floods there. Workers are struggling to reach communities devastated by the flood, including hundreds of workers trapped inside hydropower tunnels. NBC’s Janis Mackey Frayer reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Kalshi permanently bans George Santos after he secretly bet on himself
headlines.description: Kalshi has issued a lifetime ban to former Rep. George Santos after he secretly placed a bet against his own unannounced plans to attend the State of the Union.

headlines.title: Bootleg ‘Spider-Man’ swings into Russian cinemas despite Hollywood boycott
headlines.description: While screening the movie “violates both Russian and international law,” everyone, including Russian authorities, “turns a blind eye to it,” one film critic told NBC News.

headlines.title: Lionel Messi announces retirement from Argentina soccer team
headlines.description: Lionel Messi announced his retirement from the Argentina's national soccer team. Messi played in six World Cups, winning in 2022 and playing in the 2014 and 2026 finals. He will continue playing for the MLS club Inter Miami. NBC News' Andrew Greif reports.

headlines.title: Kornacki Cam: Watch Steve analyze Massachusetts primary election results
headlines.description: NBC News chief data analyst Steve Kornacki breaks down real-time vote tallies from primary elections in Massachusetts, while giving viewers a behind-the-scenes look at election night coverage.

headlines.title: Florida bans Flock and other license plate readers from state highways as backlash grows
headlines.description: Florida’s state transportation office revoked the ability of local police to put license plate readers on state highways.
